headline: Linn Mercy, Fishermans Row Now Colonial; Gutter Back to Wardens
war_summary: Since the last edition, Linn Mercy has moved to undivided Colonial ownership; the final Warden post in the region is gone, though Rotdust and Lathair saw heavy exchanges through the night. Fishermans Row likewise lost its last Warden outpost, with the 24-hour activity centered on Fort Ember, leaving all nine bases Colonial. Gutter has reversed course: The Parras, held by the Colonials at last report, has returned to Warden hands, and the region now stands seven Warden posts to none. Stonecradle has lost one Warden strongpoint to neutral rubble; its count now reads six Colonial, two Warden, one neutral, with action at The Reach, Buckler Sound, and The Heir's Knife. Weathered Expanse remains six Warden against three Colonial, though Crow's Nest dominated the overnight event ledger. Farranac Coast still holds two Warden posts against nine Colonial, with recent exchanges at Transient Valley and The Bone Haft. Heavy casualty totals are led by Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse. Elsewhere the strategic-base wire is mostly quiet, and no faction has yet reached the thirty-four victory towns required.
